nodes.name: train-xgboost-v7-full-backfill.py
nodes.summary: Standalone training script for XGBoost v7 viral prediction model using a full backfill of feature data from Supabase; trains and evaluates on the complete dataset with no holdout split.
nodes.languageNotes: Python ML training script that fetches feature rows from Supabase REST API, runs train_and_evaluate over multiple feature sets, and writes a trained model artifact.

nodes.name: fetch_from_supabase
nodes.summary: Fetches paginated feature rows for completed prediction runs from the Supabase REST API, normalizing fields for downstream training.

nodes.name: check_coverage
nodes.summary: Reports per-feature non-null coverage across the loaded training rows to surface sparsely-populated columns before training.

nodes.name: train_and_evaluate
nodes.summary: Trains an XGBoost regressor on the supplied feature columns and labels, then evaluates with Spearman rank correlation and prints feature importances.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Driver that loads env, fetches all rows, runs coverage checks, executes multiple training experiments across feature sets, and persists the final model.

nodes.name: train-xgboost-v7-holdout.py
nodes.summary: XGBoost v7 training script that pulls features from Supabase, splits into train/holdout sets, and evaluates generalization on the held-out portion.

nodes.name: fetch_from_supabase
nodes.summary: Paginates Supabase REST endpoint to load prediction-run features used as training inputs for the holdout run.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the v7 holdout experiment: loads env, pulls rows, performs train/holdout split, fits XGBoost, and reports holdout Spearman ρ.

nodes.name: train-xgboost-v7-phase1-final.py
nodes.summary: Final Phase-1 XGBoost v7 training script that consolidates the agreed feature set and produces the production candidate model artifact.

nodes.name: fetch_from_supabase
nodes.summary: Pulls completed prediction-run feature rows from Supabase, paginated to bypass row limits, for the Phase-1 final training corpus.

nodes.name: train_and_evaluate
nodes.summary: Trains XGBoost on the Phase-1 final feature set and reports Spearman rank correlation plus feature importances.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Drives the Phase-1 final pipeline: data fetch, feature selection, fit, evaluation, and serialization of the candidate v7 model.

nodes.name: train-xgboost-v7-phase1.py
nodes.summary: Phase-1 exploratory XGBoost v7 training script that iterates over multiple feature subsets to probe which signals carry predictive lift.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Runs multiple Phase-1 experiments, comparing baseline and expanded feature sets on Spearman ρ to inform the next v7 iteration.

nodes.name: fetch_from_supabase
nodes.summary: Paginated Supabase REST loader returning the Phase-1 training rows with all candidate feature columns.

nodes.name: train-xgboost-v7-with-segment.py
nodes.summary: XGBoost v7 variant that augments the feature set with segment-level (intra-video) statistics to evaluate whether segmentation features improve ρ.

nodes.name: fetch_from_supabase
nodes.summary: Loads completed prediction-run features (including segment-aware columns) from Supabase REST in paginated batches.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Runs the segment-augmented v7 experiment, training and reporting Spearman ρ to compare against the no-segment baseline.

nodes.name: train-xgboost-v7-with-vision.py
nodes.summary: XGBoost v7 variant adding Gemini-Vision-derived features (Pack V scores) to the training matrix to test whether vision signals improve viral prediction.

nodes.name: fetch_from_supabase
nodes.summary: Pulls feature rows joined with Pack V (vision rubric) outputs from Supabase REST, paginated for full coverage.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Drives the vision-augmented experiment: trains XGBoost on baseline + vision features and compares Spearman ρ to the no-vision run.

nodes.name: train-xgboost-v8.py
nodes.summary: XGBoost v8 training script that supersedes v7 with refined feature handling and expanded backfilled columns; produces the next-gen viral prediction model.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the v8 training run: feature selection, model fit, Spearman evaluation, importance reporting, and model serialization.

nodes.name: fetch_from_supabase
nodes.summary: Paginated Supabase REST loader for v8 training rows, with broader column coverage than the v7 variants.

nodes.name: transcribe-videos.py
nodes.summary: Whisper-based transcription pipeline that downloads videos missing transcripts from Supabase, extracts audio with ffmpeg, transcribes locally, and writes results back.

nodes.name: get_videos_without_transcripts
nodes.summary: Queries Supabase for video rows that are missing transcripts and returns them for processing.

nodes.name: download_video
nodes.summary: Downloads a video file from its source URL to a local temp path for downstream audio extraction.

nodes.name: extract_audio
nodes.summary: Invokes ffmpeg to extract a WAV audio track from the downloaded video, suitable for Whisper input.

nodes.name: transcribe_audio
nodes.summary: Runs Whisper on the extracted audio and returns the transcript text.

nodes.name: update_transcript
nodes.summary: Persists the transcript text back to the source video row in Supabase via REST PATCH.

nodes.name: process_video
nodes.summary: End-to-end per-video pipeline: download, extract audio, transcribe, update transcript, and clean up temp files.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Top-level driver that loops over untranscribed videos and runs the per-video pipeline with logging and error handling.

nodes.name: update-audio-samples.js
nodes.summary: One-shot Node script that updates audio sample rows in Supabase and verifies that all expected entries are present.

nodes.name: checkAllCompleted
nodes.summary: Queries Supabase to confirm every expected audio sample row exists and reports any gaps.

nodes.name: v12-step1-export-data.py
nodes.summary: Step 1 of the v12 training pipeline — exports labeled prediction-run features from Supabase to local CSV for offline training.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Loads env, pages through Supabase to fetch labeled feature rows, flattens nested fields, and writes a CSV ready for v12 training.

nodes.name: v12-step2-train.js
nodes.summary: Pure-JavaScript gradient boosted tree trainer for the v12 model that consumes the step-1 CSV and reports Spearman ρ on a held-out split.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements histogram-binned regression trees and a small GBM loop in pure JS, with seeded PRNG (mulberry32) for reproducibility.

nodes.name: rankArray
nodes.summary: Returns the rank vector of a numeric array, handling ties via average ranks, used as input to Spearman ρ.

nodes.name: spearmanRho
nodes.summary: Computes Spearman rank correlation between two numeric arrays as the model evaluation metric.

nodes.name: evaluate
nodes.summary: Evaluates a trained model against a holdout split, reporting Spearman ρ and additional diagnostic metrics.

nodes.name: HistBin
nodes.summary: Histogram-bin helper that buckets feature values for fast split-finding during regression-tree training.

nodes.name: buildTree
nodes.summary: Builds a single regression decision tree by recursively choosing the best split across binned features, with depth and min-samples constraints.

nodes.name: trainGBM
nodes.summary: Boosts an ensemble of regression trees against residuals with a learning rate to produce the final v12 GBM model.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Driver that parses CLI args, loads the CSV, builds train/holdout matrices, fits the GBM, evaluates, and writes the model JSON.

nodes.name: v12-step2-train.py
nodes.summary: Python reference implementation of v12 training (paired with the JS version) that uses NumPy and reports Spearman ρ; useful for cross-checking the JS trainer.

nodes.name: rank_array
nodes.summary: Computes the rank vector of an input array with tie averaging, mirroring the JS implementation.

nodes.name: evaluate
nodes.summary: Evaluates predictions against ground truth with Spearman ρ and side metrics, used to confirm parity with the JS trainer.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the Python v12 training run: loads CSV, builds matrices, standardizes features, fits a model, and reports ρ.

nodes.name: validate-new-features.ts
nodes.summary: TypeScript validator that pulls feature rows and ground-truth labels, then ranks newly added features by Spearman ρ to decide which to keep.

nodes.name: spearmanR
nodes.summary: Computes Spearman rank correlation between two number arrays (handles ties) as the core ranking metric.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Loads labeled rows, computes per-feature Spearman ρ vs. ground truth, and prints a ranked report of new feature usefulness.

nodes.name: validate-prediction-accuracy.ts
nodes.summary: End-to-end TypeScript validator that compares predicted VPS against actual post-publication VPS to report calibration and Spearman ρ.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Pulls prediction runs with measured outcomes, joins predicted vs actual VPS, computes ρ and tier accuracy, and prints the calibration report.

nodes.name: validate-predictions.js
nodes.summary: Node CLI that walks recent prediction runs and validates that scores, tiers, and explanations are internally consistent before being shown to users.

nodes.name: validatePredictions
nodes.summary: Loads recent prediction-run records and asserts a series of invariants (VPS vs tier, presence of recommendations, etc.), printing pass/fail per check.

nodes.name: verify_integration.ts
nodes.summary: Integration sanity check that runs a fixed prediction through the live pipeline and asserts the response shape, score ranges, and component outputs match expectations.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Drives the integration check: loads env, executes the prediction flow, and runs structural and value assertions on the result.

nodes.name: verify-classifications.js
nodes.summary: Node script that verifies classification labels assigned to videos in Supabase are well-formed and self-consistent across related tables.

nodes.name: verifyClassifications
nodes.summary: Loads classification rows, checks for missing/mismatched labels, and prints a per-record verification report.

nodes.name: verify-completion.ts
nodes.summary: Generic milestone-completion verifier that runs a battery of structural and runtime checks (files exist, exports present, env vars set) for a project phase.

nodes.name: runCheck
nodes.summary: Executes a single named check function, formats pass/fail output, and aggregates totals into the verification report.

nodes.name: verify-dps-formula-correct.js
nodes.summary: Verifies the corrected DPS (Dynamic Percentile System) formula against a curated sample of videos and prints discrepancies between expected and computed scores.

nodes.name: verify-dps-results.ts

nodes.name: verifyResults
nodes.summary: Reads recent DPS result rows and validates each against bound and tier-mapping rules, logging any violations.

nodes.name: verify-env.js
nodes.summary: Tiny CLI that checks the presence of required environment variables and exits non-zero if any are missing, used as a pre-flight gate.

nodes.name: verify-evolution-engine-completion.js
nodes.summary: Verifies the Evolution Engine milestone is fully wired by checking for expected files, key code patterns, and registry entries.

nodes.name: verifyEvolutionEngineCompletion
nodes.summary: Runs a battery of file-existence and content-pattern checks proving each Evolution Engine sub-feature is implemented.

nodes.name: verify-feedback-loader.ts

nodes.name: verify-frameworks-setup.ts
nodes.summary: Verifies the prediction frameworks (packs, registry, schedulers) are correctly registered and reachable, used after framework setup changes.

nodes.name: verifySetup
nodes.summary: Walks the framework registry, verifies each pack/component is wired and reachable, and prints a pass/fail summary.
